parties: RPSG Ventures Limited; Quest Capital Markets Limited
headline: Quest Capital Markets files SEBI Takeover Regulation disclosure for RPSG Ventures
sum: Quest Capital Markets has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Reg. 31(4) in respect of RPSG Ventures Limited, signalling a potential change of control or threshold-crossing shareholding event requiring immediate market transparency.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is a gating item in takeover law-it triggers public announcement, OSA/OFS mechanics, and open offer obligations within 4 days; counsel must immediately audit the acquirer's concert party status, exempt thresholds, and intent declarations to determine whether a full mandatory open offer is triggered.
detail: Quest Capital Markets Limited has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, in relation to RPSG Ventures Limited. This disclosure is the statutory trigger requiring any acquirer who crosses 25% shareholding or intends to acquire control to notify the exchange within 4 days. The filing is a procedural milestone preceding any open offer announcement or negotiated acquisition framework.
